limits: Identities are scoped by section; identical labels never merge records.
Payload variants remain in the original exports; compact indices reference their exact locale, file hash, section and index.
Missing names have no synthetic fallback; index descriptions preserve source values.
Unresolved references may target native types or data outside this release; they are not deleted.
Client records may be hidden or unreleased; presence does not establish gameplay availability.
This projection is queryable, not a complete combat model. Numeric conflicts remain visible.
Official-export sections retain their original structure; not an engine-ready complete mechanics catalog.
An unchanged source index does not prove equivalence to any particular installed client build.
Language zh denotes Simplified Chinese, not the China server.

limitations: Resource inventory may include hidden or unreleased items; it is not an availability list.
Only allowlisted own facts are exported; arrays retain source indices and are not merged.
Native defaults, scripts, full evolution routes and final damage are not reconstructed.
Missing data remains unknown. No other region is used to fill gaps.

limits: Region evidence is supplied by the operator; no automatic server-region detection.
Only declared structured exports are imported; not a complete-client or combat-coverage assertion.
Official table is manually published with updates, not necessarily every hotfix; completeness is not guaranteed.
Percentages retain the published decimal precision; no renormalization or exact underlying-weight claim.
Pool gates above 100 percent are preserved as source values, not interpreted as single-trial probabilities.
Under-review rows remain flagged, including published 0.00 percent; they do not prove an impossible drop.
Names are source labels, not internal item identities. Same-release identity resolution is required.
Inverse indexes retain their direction and duplicate rows; never sum them as independent rewards.
Inputs retain independent version identities; matching region does not establish matching game revision.
Canonical projection must be regenerated. No source overwrites another source's conflicting data.
